notes: This theme is largely a dead end on GitHub. CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield, and STR/CoStar hotel-supply reports are proprietary/subscription products (STR Benchmark, CoStar's Hospitality module, CBRE Hotels Research, JLL Hotel Investment Highlights); none of these firms publish machine-readable data feeds, and no independent scraper/mirror of their PDFs or dashboards was found. WebSearch's session-wide budget (200/200) was exhausted before this scout could run any queries with it, so this run relied entirely on WebFetch against Bing/DuckDuckGo results pages and 5 gh search repos calls (one over the nominal 4-call allowance, all low-cost). DuckDuckGo (html. and lite. subdomains) refused connections outright (ECONNREFUSED) for every attempt. Bing's WebFetch summaries were unreliable for `site:github.com` operators combined with extra keywords — the summarizer model kept reporting zero GitHub links even though ~500k Bing results were nominally returned, and repeatedly substituted generic commercial hotel-booking sites (Hotels.com, Expedia, Trivago, etc.) instead of parsing the actual SERP; plain-keyword Bing queries without site: fared no better. GitHub's own topic pages (hotel-industry, hotel-data, revpar, hospitality) and gh search repos were the only channels that returned real repo lists, and none touch CBRE/JLL/Cushman/STR data specifically — everything surfaced is either (a) single-property ML/BI coursework on Kaggle-style booking-cancellation data (already excluded per instructions), (b) scrapers of consumer OTAs/Airbnb itself, or (c) yield-management method libraries with no data. Recommend a future pass try GitHub Code Search (not repo search) for literal strings like 'CoStar' or 'STR Global' inside notebooks/scripts, or check Zenodo/Kaggle/OSF directly for academic hotel-supply panels that might cross-link to a GitHub replication repo — none were found in this session's budget. If another scout has WebSearch budget remaining, targeted queries worth re-running verbatim: 'site:github.com CoStar hospitality data', 'site:github.com "STR Global" hotel', 'site:github.com Cushman Wakefield hotel report data'.
